name: Godot
description: Finds Godot projects and the Godot editor, opens the editor on a project, and teaches agents to run, stop, reload and capture scenes through the project's own Godot MCP server.

slashCommands.name: godot-play
slashCommands.description: Run the Godot project and check the result
slashCommands.prompt: Run this Godot project with the project's Godot MCP server (play_scene), wait for it to start, take a screenshot with get_game_screenshot and tell me what you see and any errors in the debug output. Stop the scene when you are done.

slashCommands.name: godot-editor
slashCommands.description: Open this project in the Godot editor
slashCommands.prompt: Use godot_info to find this project's Godot project and editor, then open it with godot_open_editor.
